visual.general_description: Grouped bar chart of three symptom measures (PSS-SR, BDI, BAI) at four time points: Baseline, During treatment (NET-session 4), Post treatment and Follow up.
visual.detailed_description: A grouped bar chart on a white background with four category groups along the horizontal axis, printed Baseline, During treatment (NET-session 4), Post treatment and Follow up. Each group has three adjacent bars in the order black, light beige and gray, matching the legend entries PSS-SR, BDI and BAI at the right. The vertical axis has printed tick labels 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 with horizontal gridlines, no axis title and no printed data labels. The three bars of the Baseline group are taller than the bars of the During treatment and Post treatment groups, and the bars of those two middle groups are close to one another in height within each group. In the Follow up group the black and beige bars are close in height to each other and the gray bar is clearly taller than both, and taller than the gray bars of the two middle groups. No patient names, dates or other identifiers are printed.

caption_claims.value: Caption states the chart shows measurement of symptoms of PTSD, depression and anxiety during the course of treatment, defines PSS-SR, BDI and BAI, and gives cut-offs of 20 for the BDI-II, 17 for the BAI and 14 for the PSS-SR for clinically significant levels.

evidence.quote:
Figure 1.
Measurement of symptoms of PTSD, depression, and anxiety during the course of treatment.PSS-SR = Posttraumatic Symptom Scale Self-Report, BDI = Beck Depression Inventory II, BAI = Beck Anxiety Inventory. Cut-offs for clinically significant levels of symptoms are 20 for the BDI-II, 17 for the BAI, and 14 for the PSS-SR.

clinical_significance.statement: Authors cite Figure 1 for the decline in posttraumatic, depressive and anxiety symptoms by post-treatment.

evidence.quote: there was a decline in posttraumatic, depressive, and anxiety symptoms by post-treatment (see Figure 1)

limitations: Bars carry no printed values; the caption cut-off values are caption text and are not matched to any printed axis mark.
